name: 29542-fixedlenspec-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (target, the standard ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights) + RedHatAI/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-speculator.eagle3 (EAGLE3 drafter, 3 speculative tokens); ~18 GB of bf16 weights together.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1024 requests.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed shape: exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 output tokens, zero variance, greedy decoding (temperature 0), ignore_eos so every request runs to its 1024-token cap.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant with a draft model, serving 256 concurrent users 1024-token prompts and full-length replies on one GPU.
launch:
# Structured values below are one-line JSON on purpose: the reader is line-based and silently
# drops indented block keys, so re-flowing one of those lines drops the key at rc=0.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# This engine refuses async scheduling with any speculative method outside the EAGLE/MTP family.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "RedHatAI/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-speculator.eagle3", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}

async-scheduling: true

# This engine refuses pipeline_parallel_size > 1 with async scheduling.
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16
kv-cache-dtype: fp8

max-model-len: 2560
max-num-seqs: 512
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false

compilation-config: {"max_cudagraph_capture_size": 2048}
